about_the_game:
Fallen Seeds II — Demo (Lily’s Route, Day 1)
This standalone demo lets you play the opening day of Lily’s route in our story-driven sci-fi visual novel about trust, rebellion, and the mystery known as the Zone.

What’s included in this demo

  • The full first in-game day of Lily’s route with multiple dialogue choices and branching reactions.

  • A focused slice of the core experience: narrative exploration, character interaction, relationship changes.

  • Several playable scenes and locations that set up the tone, stakes, and art direction of Fallen Seeds II.

What’s not included

  • Other routes (Kaya, Sif, Ada, etc.), later days, and end-game content.

  • Some systems, settings, and features planned for the full release.

Languages

  • Interface & subtitles: English, Russian.

  • No voice-over in this demo.
